author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
What should you do it yourself, what should you give it to AI?

1. If it increases the knowledge in your brain, do it yourself.   AI can't learn for you

2. If it increases $ in your bank account, do it yourself.  You have to be the moat itself on how to make money, or other people will take away your profit with their AI.

3. If it builds relationship with other humans, do it yourself.  We are not living in the Matrix (yet)

4. If it earns you good karma, do it yourself.   AI can't go to heaven instead of your soul.

Everything else, give it to AI.
